anchor.quote: The mind runs multiple processes simultaneously — and they interfere.

claims.rationale: The excerpt literalizes mind-states as concurrently executing processes that interfere, but gives no process definition, measure, conditions, or source. The computational structure is unoperationalized.

legacy.quote: "The mind runs multiple processes simultaneously — and they interfere."
legacy.note: A literal process-interference mechanism is asserted in frontmatter and repeated in the body.

anchor.quote: trauma container bleeds into the joy container

claims.rationale: Trauma and joy are presented as literal containers without an analogy marker or defined state boundary. The sentence conflates an undeclared computing metaphor with an empirical mechanism.

legacy.quote: "trauma container bleeds into the joy container"
legacy.note: Trauma and joy become literal containers, a claim repeated in the breach section.

anchor.quote: The chakra system is a pre-digital containerization architecture.

claims.rationale: The pre-digital containerization identity combines chakra tradition and Linux concepts without tracing either ingredient, declaring Noesis authorship, or marking a metaphor; the computational identity is unsupported.

legacy.quote: "The chakra system is a pre-digital containerization architecture."
legacy.note: The literal chakra/container identity repeats at hero L35 and body L44.

anchor.quote: your father's voice is running in the same namespace. Not metaphorically.

claims.rationale: “Not metaphorically” explicitly upgrades the namespace comparison to a literal mechanism, but no namespace, process isolation, or measure exists for the remembered voice.

legacy.quote: "your father's voice is running in the same namespace. Not metaphorically."
legacy.note: The literal namespace upgrade repeats throughout and is not occurrence-load-bearing.

anchor.quote: The amygdala is firing survival code while the prefrontal cortex is trying

claims.rationale: The sentence combines neural-region activity, causal authorship, and unmarked “survival code.” Separate the physiology from the computational comparison and do not treat brain regions as literal software agents.

legacy.quote: "The amygdala is firing survival code while the prefrontal cortex is trying"
legacy.note: Neural regions become causal authors, but the larger container thesis survives this local claim.

anchor.quote: The sympathetic and parasympathetic branches are not enemies

claims.rationale: “Not enemies” is an openly figurative comparison of the measurable sympathetic and parasympathetic branches, and the adjacent Hermetic-poles framing makes the non-literal boundary explicit.

legacy.quote: "The sympathetic and parasympathetic branches are not enemies"
legacy.note: The paired autonomic branches are measurable physiology; calling them Hermetic poles is declared house framing.

anchor.quote: The chakra system is a containerization architecture that predates Linux namespaces

claims.rationale: The chakra/containerization identity is repeated as literal architecture and historical priority without a traditional source, transformation trace, Noesis authorship marker, or declared metaphor.

legacy.quote: "The chakra system is a containerization architecture that predates Linux namespaces"
legacy.note: The literal architecture claim repeats at L11/L35 and elsewhere.

anchor.quote: The Taittirīya Upaniṣad (II.1–5) maps this precisely

claims.rationale: Taittirīya Upaniṣad II.1–5 presents the five kośas; it does not map host kernels, schedulers, process tables, system calls, or orchestration. “Maps this precisely” materially misattributes the modern synthesis.

legacy.quote: "The Taittirīya Upaniṣad (II.1–5) maps this precisely"
legacy.note: The text does not map Linux constructs, and five mappings plus later compose mappings carry the analogy.

anchor.quote: When you eat, blood diverts to the digestive namespace

claims.rationale: Demand-related circulation changes are plausible, but “digestive namespace” silently fuses the observation with an undefined computing mechanism. Split the physiology from a clearly declared analogy.

legacy.quote: "When you eat, blood diverts to the digestive namespace"
legacy.note: Demand-related circulation changes are observable; “namespace” remains the surrounding systems analogy.

anchor.quote: This triad is not decorative. It is structural.

claims.rationale: The Kha-Ba-La triad is explicitly named as house structure and the paragraph performs three separate removal tests. Its three terms, structural consequence, and in-post provenance all pass.

legacy.quote: "This triad is not decorative. It is structural."
legacy.note: The paragraph performs the removal test for Kha, Ba, and La one by one; removing the triad collapses its argument.

anchor.quote: the system drifts toward heat death; without resistance, there is no form

claims.rationale: Removing generic psychological resistance does not entail thermodynamic heat death, and entropy is not identical to drag. The thermodynamic mapping is false and removable.

legacy.quote: "the system drifts toward heat death; without resistance, there is no form"
legacy.note: Thermodynamic heat death does not follow from removing generic psychological resistance, and entropy is not drag.

anchor.quote: Cortisol leaks into the relational processing queue. Oxytocin signaling gets deprioritized.

claims.rationale: No measures support cortisol “leaking” into a relationship queue or oxytocin being scheduled downward. Hormonal correlates, causal authorship, and an undeclared queue metaphor are conflated.

legacy.quote: "Cortisol leaks into the relational processing queue. Oxytocin signaling gets deprioritized."
legacy.note: Hormones are silently cast as the scheduler of relationship experience rather than physical correlates.

anchor.quote: The heart begins to process relationships as survival threats.

claims.rationale: The heart is said to process relationships as threats without an operational organ-level measure, population, condition, or source. Reframe as a scoped felt experience or support the empirical mechanism.

legacy.quote: "The heart begins to process relationships as survival threats."
legacy.note: A literal organ-level relationship-processing mechanism is asserted without a defined measure.

anchor.quote: a buffer overflow with physiological consequences

claims.rationale: “Buffer overflow” is a specific computing failure silently upgraded to a physiological mechanism. No buffer, capacity, write, or overflow condition is defined.

legacy.quote: "a buffer overflow with physiological consequences"
legacy.note: Computing language is silently upgraded to a literal physiological mechanism.

anchor.quote: Kṛṣṇa does not tell him to hold space for his anxiety

claims.rationale: Bhagavad Gītā 6.34–35 is named and the restless-wind, abhyāsa, and vairāgya teaching is represented faithfully; the source claim is distinct from the later systems translation.

legacy.quote: "Kṛṣṇa does not tell him to hold space for his anxiety"
legacy.note: The Gītā passage is used as Vedic operating grammar; its systems translation is openly declared as translation.

anchor.quote: Attention is zero-sum.

claims.rationale: “Zero-sum” asserts a conserved attention quantity, but no resource metric, conditions, population, or source is given. The universal empirical and mathematical strength is unsupported.

legacy.quote: "Attention is zero-sum."
legacy.note: The universal attention model is local to this paragraph and does not carry the chakra-container thesis.

anchor.quote: one greedy process starves the others indefinitely

claims.rationale: Linux CFS is designed to apportion runtime fairly; absence of cpu.cfs_quota_us does not mean one greedy process starves all others indefinitely. The computational claim is false.

legacy.quote: "one greedy process starves the others indefinitely"
legacy.note: CFS generally apportions runtime, and the central analogy survives this false local claim's deletion.

anchor.quote: Your nervous system operates under the same constraint.

claims.rationale: The nervous-system equivalence inherits the false CFS premise and supplies no common scheduler, unit, or resource measure. The cross-domain synthesis is neither traced nor correct.

legacy.quote: "Your nervous system operates under the same constraint."
legacy.note: No common scheduler or resource metric establishes the claimed equivalence.

anchor.quote: It is a dependency graph.

claims.rationale: The chakra ordering is labeled a dependency graph without defined vertices, edges, dependency semantics, or an explicit Noesis/metaphor boundary. The mathematical structure is misapplied.

legacy.quote: "It is a dependency graph."
legacy.note: Removing the graph label leaves the invented sequential chakra/kośa claims intact; no formal dependency relation is established.

anchor.quote: The entropy that eventually stops every container is the friction

claims.rationale: Entropy is not a universal timer that stops every container, is not synonymous with friction, and does not imply that system failure is necessary for learning.

legacy.quote: "The entropy that eventually stops every container is the friction"
legacy.note: Entropy is neither a universal container shutdown timer nor synonymous with friction or necessary learning.

anchor.quote: This is topological inspection.

claims.rationale: No topology, neighborhood, invariant, or transformation is defined; “topological inspection” is an unproven mathematical label with no structural consequence or provenance.

legacy.quote: "This is topological inspection."
legacy.note: No topology, invariant, neighborhood, or transformation is demonstrated; the paragraph survives after deleting the term.

anchor.quote: The Quine is complete when the container no longer needs the containerizer.

claims.rationale: A quine is a program that reproduces its own source representation; container independence does not instantiate that property. The term is definitionally misapplied.

legacy.quote: "The Quine is complete when the container no longer needs the containerizer."
legacy.note: A Quine is a self-reproducing program; container independence does not demonstrate that mathematical/computational property.
